items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: But that turned out to be a very successful tour, and I met a lot of musicians on there, particularly from the Stan Kenton band.

ctx.x: So they decided to do the show again and call it The Biggest Show of 1952. This show featured the Nat King Cole Trio as the headliner, and then they had Stan Kenton's band, Sarah Vaughan, George Kirby, Peg Leg Bates, Stump and Stumpy, and a few other personalities that doesn't come to mind immediately.
But that turned out to be a very successful tour, and I met a lot of musicians on there, particularly from the Stan Kenton band. Guys like Lee Konitz...
